name: Firmament
overview: The firmament, described in Genesis 1 as an expanse created by God to separate the waters above from the waters below, is a foundational element of the created order. God called this expanse Heaven, establishing it on the second day of creation as a distinct realm. Within this firmament, God placed the celestial lights—the sun, moon, and stars—to govern day and night, and to serve as signs for seasons, days, and years, demonstrating His sovereign design over time and space.
